scenes.basis: 9:3 "he got close to Damascus"; 9:8 "They led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus" - the journey's following action is at Damascus
9:10 "there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias"
9:11 "go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul"; 9:17 "Ananias departed, and entered into the house"
9:19 "Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus"; 9:20 "in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ"
9:26 "When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples"
9:30 "they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him off to Tarsus" - the send-off is from Caesarea
9:31 "So the assemblies throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace" - a summary over three regions with no single setting
9:32 "he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda"
9:36 "there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha"; 9:39 "Peter got up and went with them"
